name: forge
description: Nền ERP tương thích Frappe chạy trên Cloudflare — kernel CloudForge + Desk/builder MetaForge

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run server:typecheck && pnpm run client:typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run server:test && pnpm run client:test
scripts.build: pnpm run server:build && pnpm run client:build
scripts.verify: pnpm run server:check && pnpm --filter cloudforge run test:workers && pnpm run client:typecheck && pnpm run client:test && pnpm run client:build
scripts.release:check: node server/scripts/release-preflight.mjs && pnpm run security:audit && pnpm run verify && pnpm --filter cloudforge run verify:manifest
